messages.subject: Step count Error
parts:
Dear all,
First of all, thank you very much for your support.

I've been using the GGIR package since months without any kind of problem. Recently when i run the analysis adding the code "myfun=myfun" to detect step count and error that you find in the screenshot in attached appear.    

Do you have a suggestion on what might be the issue?


Thankyou very much,
Luca

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Step count Error
parts:
As I mentioned to in another thread last week:

This was a bug introduced in 3.0-6 and fixed in 3.0-7 (only on GitHub for now) and affects the use of the external function embedding option (such as verisense step count).

In 3.0-6 part 1 had undergone a major clean up (credits to contributor Lena), which has made the code a lot more readable and efficient. Despite extensive testing this was one of the side effects, but luckily now fixed.

Vincent
